name: quick_icebreaker
description: Just talk: nobody speaks after the Table starts listening, so the icebreaker is decided at 3.0 s (one, never a second). Then a lively exchange; the 30 s cooldown after the icebreaker holds the first steer back until 36.0 s, and a later pause gets it 3 s after the last turn.

turns.text: Ha, okay, I guess I'm here because my roommate dragged me to this.
Same honestly, my lab mate said the free food was worth it.
Is it, though? I only saw those sad little sandwiches by the door.
Okay fair, but the coffee is good, I already had two cups of it.
Two cups at night is bold, are you planning to stay up coding or what?
Kind of, I have a robotics demo on Friday and the arm still drifts left.
Wait, a real robot arm? What is it supposed to do once it works?
It sorts recycling, in theory, right now it mostly throws cans at people.
